hardwareHubs.note: Oak Ridge National Laboratory hosts Innovation Crossroads, which embeds startup founders for two years with access to the DOE Manufacturing Demonstration Facility.
Vanderbilt's Wond'ry innovation center runs makerspaces and hosts the annual TN Maker Fest.
The city designated a 140 acre downtown Innovation District in 2015 to cluster startups, incubators and accelerators.

makerspaces.name: Make Nashville
makerspaces.note: Its site lists FDM 3D printers, CNC mills, a CO2 laser, a metal shop with welding, and an electronics lab.

makerspaces.name: Knox Makers
makerspaces.note: Volunteer-run nonprofit whose site lists 3D printing, laser cutting, machining, metalworking, electronics and woodworking areas.

makerspaces.name: ChattLab
makerspaces.note: About 5,000 square feet on the North Shore with woodworking, metalworking, 3D printing and electronics tools, per the state arts commission listing.

events.name: TN Maker Fest
events.note: Free family event at the Wond'ry held each fall, with the 2025 edition on October 4 and the next listed for September 26, 2026.

programs.name: Innovation Crossroads
programs.note: DOE lab-embedded entrepreneurship fellowship at Oak Ridge National Laboratory with access to the Manufacturing Demonstration Facility.

programs.name: The Wond'ry, Vanderbilt University
programs.note: Vanderbilt's innovation center with makerspaces and programs for student and faculty inventors.

specialties.name: Automotive manufacturing
specialties.note: The state automotive cluster is anchored by Nissan in Smyrna, GM in Spring Hill and Volkswagen in Chattanooga.

specialties.name: Advanced manufacturing research
specialties.note: Oak Ridge hosts the Manufacturing Demonstration Facility, described as DOE's largest advanced manufacturing research center.

specialties.name: Nuclear industry supply chain
specialties.note: The state MEP center lists the nuclear industry as one of its support areas for manufacturers.

support.name: Tennessee Manufacturing Extension Partnership (TMEP)
support.note: The state's NIST MEP center, housed in the University of Tennessee Center for Industrial Services, offering consulting on continuous improvement, quality, supply chain and workforce.
